description: The first record of a deployment's start stream. Signed by the bootstrap key the node made for itself, before any customer key exists. It states which published definitions the node built itself from, which is the exact version of the API, and carries the bootstrap key.

bootstrapKey.description: A public key: a registered algorithm and the key's bytes in strict padded base64.

deployment.description: The deployment's name, as it appears in its stream names.

details.description: Issuer-defined detail: up to 64 named scalars. Nothing in it is interpreted by the base kinds, and nothing in it is content; content goes behind a reference.

publication.description: The DefinitionPublished record the node took its definitions from.

publisher.description: The key that signed that publication.
